lines.description: Natural gas — pyrolysis furnace + secondary combustion chamber (二燃室)
lines.status: PLANNING ESTIMATE (blueprint session) — Lishui NG actual awaited
lines.design_decision: Secondary combustion chamber is the mainstream China option for dismantling/crushing off-gas; RTO NOT used (HF attacks ceramic media, dust clogging, ~1,100 C / >=2 s residence needed for dioxin control under HJ 1186-2021). Quench + alkali scrubbing follows.

lines.description: Hydromet line (NCM + LFP black mass, 35 kt/a combined)
Process water in / wastewater out — pretreated on-site to GB 31573-2015, discharged to municipal sewer
lines.note: No ZLD required; pretreat-to-sewer is a siting advantage carried into the international module design

design_decisions.pre_treatment: Nitrogen-inerted shredding of charged packs — NO discharge (放电) station anywhere. Where discharge is used at other facilities it is chemistry-agnostic (no separate NCM/LFP discharge).
design_decisions.tail_gas: Secondary combustion chamber (二燃室), not RTO.
design_decisions.compliance: GB 31573-2015 (inorganic chemical emissions) + HJ 1186-2021 (waste Li-ion traction battery treatment); wastewater pretreated on-site then municipal sewer.
